articleTitle: Dual-mode sensor information acquisition system design
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: When the satellite signal is interfered, the dual-mode sensor information acquisition system can assist the autonomous navigation and positioning by collecting the data of different sensors. This paper mainly completes four parts: the overall design of the system, the realization of the system hardware, the design of the system software and the verification of the experimental results. The system is finally integrated on the PCB board, using AR0134 binocular vision image acquisition unit and XC-IMUM05 micro inertial measurement unit to collect external information, using FPGA to process the collected information in parallel and upload it to the upper computer through the USB2.0 interface module for real-time display. Based on the time synchronization algorithm and the corresponding hardware and software system, the synchronous output of micro-inertial measurement unit data and binocular vision image data is realized by using the characteristics of FPGA parallel output, which provides the data foundation for the next integrated navigation.

articleTitle: Remote monitoring and fault diagnosis of transport ships and engineering dredging ship propulsion systems based on data fusion algorithm
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: In the realm of computational intelligence and data-driven methodologies, advanced algorithms present transformative solutions for diverse industries. Among these, the marine transportation sector, encompassing transport ships and engineering dredging ships, stands to benefit significantly. In this paper, data fusion technology is investigated, and for the problems in the process of data collection and transmission of remote monitoring module in the hazardous chemical ship management system, a data fusion algorithm based on clustering technology (DFACT) is provided, which adopts the clustering structure to reduce the network congestion, and the construction of the clusters is completed at the base station, which firstly collects the network information needed for the clustering algorithm, and then applies the PSO algorithm and the improved DCHS algorithm to realize the network clustering based on global information, and through an experiment to illustrate that the algorithm can carry out the fast data fusion of nodes, reduce the energy consumption of nodes, prolong the network lifecycle, and protect the data security, which verifies the effectiveness of the DFACT algorithm, and provides a guarantee for fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: Design and application of pseudo-random sequence base on logistic map
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: Digital image is an important information carrier. In order to prevent information from being stolen and leading to information leakage, it's very important to protect the digital image. This paper proposes a pseudo-random sequence based on logistic map and studies the encryption algorithm. First, use the logistic map to generate a logistic chaotic sequence, remove the previously poor chaotic terms and obtain a chaotic sequence with good chaotic properties. Second, sort the chaotic sequence according to certain rules and use the index of the sorted sequence to scramble the pixels of the plaintext image. Then, diffuse the scrambled image pixel matrix. By combining chaotic sequences and using the bitwise XOR method, the distribution of grayscale values in the scrambled image is changed to further improve the encryption effect. Finally, combined with the characteristics of S-box, the pixel values of the digital image are changed and complete a further encryption process. After a series of operations such as scrambling, diffusion, and pixel value replacement, the ciphertext image has reached a good confidentiality state. This paper comprehensively evaluates the encryption effect and security of the method proposed in this paper from four aspects: key analysis, histogram analysis, correlation coefficient analysis, and information entropy analysis. It is believed that the encryption effect of the algorithm is good.

articleTitle: YO-BYNet: multi-object tracking of fish based on YOLOv8 and BYTE association method
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: In the field of computer vision, multi-object tracking tasks have been widely used in the field of pedestrians and vehicles, but the application of fish is relatively scarce. Therefore, this paper takes Atlantic salmon as the research object, collects industrial recirculating aquaculture videos, and constructs a fish multi-object tracking dataset MOTSALMON for fish multi-object tracking research. The multi-object tracking task of fish is challenging. When fish swim underwater, the motion blur is serious and the motion law is highly nonlinear. In this paper, multiple scales of YOLOv8 are used as detectors combined with multiple advanced trackers to use the dataset to train the model, and the comparison experiment optimizes the model so that the model achieves good tracking effect. Based on this, this paper proposes a fish multi-object tracking model YO-BYNet, which has achieved good results in the MOTSALMON dataset established in this paper. YO-BYNet combines YOLOv8, Kalman filter and BYTE's association method, and adds NSGA-II genetic algorithm to optimize the tracker for multi-objective, and uses the advanced multi-objective tracking evaluation method HOTA to evaluate the proposed model And achieved good results.

articleTitle: Optimization of box cover plate parameters based on particle swarm optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: With the development of various computer related technologies, research on artificial intelligence related algorithms is constantly emerging, such as particle swarm optimization. At the same time, in order to optimize relevant design parameters in mechanical design and manufacturing, and obtain the optimal parameter values for these design parameters, this paper proposes a box shaped cover plate parameter optimization solution based on particle swarm optimization algorithm. This method first constructs a mathematical model based on the principles in mechanical design, mainly determining the thickness and height of the plate as the two optimization parameters, as well as the expression of the objective function Determination of constraint conditions; Subsequently, the particle swarm optimization algorithm was used to achieve cyclic iteration of the algorithm, continuously optimizing parameters. After 100 individual particle iterations of 1000 times, the global optimal solution was finally obtained, thus achieving the optimization design of box cover plate parameters. This algorithm can be promoted for use in mechanical design, manufacturing, and automation.

articleTitle: Research on the algorithm of marine radar rainfall recognition based on gray-level co-occurrence matrix and support vector machine
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: This paper proposes a greyscale covariance matrix (GLCM) and support vector machine (SVM) based rainfall recognition algorithm for marine radar to effectively identify and classify whether the radar image is rainy or not. Firstly, the marine radar images are greyscaled using the GLCM algorithm, and the obtained radar images are selected from four different angles (0°, 45°, 90°, 135°) to extract the five eigenvalues of the marine radar images, which are entropy, contrast, correlation, energy and inverse difference. Then this paper analyses the classification characteristics of the marine radar image, constructs the SVM classifier, designs and solves the optimal hyperplane, solves the recognition classification accuracy under different kernel functions, and compares with the traditional algorithm. Using the experimental data provided by the State Oceanic Administration Pingtan Marine Environment Monitoring Station to verify and compare with the traditional echo difference mean algorithm, it is concluded that the SVM classifier based on the RBF kernel function has a good classification of the marine radar image to identify whether it is raining or not, and the accuracy rate reaches 95.54%, which provides an effective method for the identification of rainfall.

articleTitle: Optimization of joint mechanism for assisted exoskeleton robot
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: Exoskeleton robots are one of the current research hotspots. In order to solve the problem of efficient power assistance for exoskeleton robots, this paper starts from the optimization design of the mechanical structure of exoskeleton robots and establishes a multi-objective optimization model for hip and knee joints. The multi-objective linear weighted optimization method is used, based on the fmincon function and genetic algorithm in MATLAB, to optimize the mechanical structure of the hip and knee joints. Additionally, the pneumatic balance rod power assistance method is employed to form a parallelogram mechanism and obtain the optimal installation position. The results show that after optimization, the driving force and stroke of the hydraulic cylinder of the hip and knee joints are significantly reduced, which reduces the overall size, weight, energy consumption, and prolongs the service life. This design provides a reference for the lightweight design of wearable intelligent equipment.

articleTitle: Emotional computing modeling method combining user preference model
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: Emotional analysis refers to the analysis and identification of emotional tendencies and emotional expressions in texts throu gh natural language processing and computer technology. In order to improve the accuracy and efficiency of user emotion recognition, t his article proposes an algorithm based on deep learning (DL) and special optimization strategy. In order to verify the effectiveness and superiority of the algorithm, the performance of SVM algorithm and this a lgorithm in terms of accuracy, recall and recognition time under different node numbers and different data scales is compared through experiments. The experimental results show that the algorithm has obvious advantages in user emotion recognition and the s tability of search efficiency. Through the use of DL and special optimization strategies, this algorithm can better capture the emotional inform ation in the text and improve the accuracy of emotional recognition. Moreover, with the increase of data scale, multi node computing can effectively improve the efficiency of emotion recognition. The research results further confirm the advantages and application value of DL in the field of natural language processing, especially in the task of sentiment analysis.

articleTitle: Research on abnormal behavior recognition algorithm based on 3D-resnet deep neural network
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: Traditional video surveillance requires a large amount of manpower and material resources, requiring manual attendance and only providing a single monitoring function. Under long-term and high traffic data conditions, duty personnel are prone to fatigue and overlook abnormal behaviors of security risks in videos. Therefore, video systems that provide intelligent recognition of abnormal behaviors in videos are particularly important, as they can help security management departments achieve intelligent security management, the abnormal behavior recognition algorithm is the core soul of the system. This article studies the use of deep learning algorithm ``3D residual deep neural network'' (referred to as 3D-Resnet) to identify three types of abnormal behavior risks in video surveillance, including: fighting, robbery, and arson hazards. The designed algorithm is applied in an intelligent recognition system for video abnormal behavior, and the experimental results show that the recognition accuracy is over 90%. The designed algorithm can effectively detect new input videos in the intelligent recognition system for video abnormal behavior, and has a good recognition effect on abnormal behavior recognition. According to experimental comparison, the neural network algorithm of 3D combined residual structure is significantly superior to C3D neural network and Two-stream neural network in identifying abnormal behavior.

articleTitle: English reading comprehension data classification based on random forest bidirectional voting mechanism
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: The rapid development of information technology has made the application of artificial intelligence more and more widespread, and English reading data classification is an important research branch, which has gradually been recognized and deeply explored by many researchers. At present, traditional English reading data classification methods face the dilemma of inaccuracy, long inference time, and inability to be applied in real-time. With the development of artificial intelligence related technologies, significant progress has been made in English reading data classification, but there is still great room to fully solve the problem. This article proposes a data classification method based on random forest bidirectional voting mechanism to address the problems faced by English reading data classification. This method first analyses the ensemble learning method of random forest and discusses the advantages that can be widely applied in data classification and non-parametric regression; Secondly, the importance of random forest convergence theorem, generalized error bound, and out of bag estimation was analysed; Finally, specific steps for improving the random forest improvement algorithm are provided. The experiment shows that the algorithm proposed in this paper performs significantly better than traditional methods on English reading corpora, improving testing efficiency and effectively improving the classification performance of English reading data without reducing the accuracy of the test set.

articleTitle: Texture enhancement in infrared and visible image fusion using triple different discriminators
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: Infrared and visible image fusion is the fusion of meaningful features from infrared and visible images to a high-quality image. During the fusion process, texture details and target contours are not clear resulting in low fused image quality. We propose a triple discriminator generative adversarial network that contains both rich textural detail and sharp contrast. The difference image can provide not only rich texture details but also clear target edges, which can contribute to preserving the unique features during the convolution process. Markov discriminator and loss function are designed to reduce the effect of high contrast on infrared image texture and enhance the extraction of texture details. Comparing qualitative and quantitative experiments with advanced fusion methods on publicly available datasets, our model has excellent visual perception and superior metric results. Using generative adversarial network model with triple discriminator to improve the image fusion performance and enhance the texture details and target contours of the fused image.

articleTitle: Multimodal LaF-CMA-ES algorithm based on homotopic convex transformation
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: Multimodal optimization is a difficult problem in the field of evolutionary computation due to multiple attraction basins. The balance of exploration and exploitation is important to the performance of the algorithm in multimodal problems. In this paper, a novel algorithm, named KbP-LaF-CMAES, is proposed based on the Covariance Matrix Adaptation Evolution Strategy (CMA-ES) to cope with the multimodal optimization problem. Two strategies, the leader and follower (LaF) mechanism and the homotopic convex transformation mechanism, are introduced in the algorithm. In the first stage of the proposed algorithm, the LaF strategy is conducted to explore the search space in a vast domain. Two co-evolutionary populations, leaders and followers evolve synergistically. When the solutions are stalled in the first stage, the KbP strategy is performed to improve the ability of exploration. In the second stage of the proposed KbP-LaF-CMAES, two variants of the CMA-ES algorithm are adopted to exploit the specific domain-containing local optimum domain, which has a potential global optimum of the problem. Finally, the experimental results on the CEC benchmark show significant improvements in the performance of KbP-LaF-CMAES than other CMA-ES variants and SPSRDEMMS. The performance of the proposed KbP-LaF-CMAES is comparable with the EBO with CMAR.

articleTitle: Anti-collision algorithm of blind source separation for RFID based on Hessian regular sparse NMF
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: The number of identification tags is greater than the number of readers, the separation effect of the underdetermined blind separation algorithm is poor, and the reading speed of the RFID system is slow. When applying non-negative matrix decomposition, NMF primarily focuses on sparse regularization of the end members while disregarding the inherent geometry of the data, which limits its ability to separate signals effectively. To overcome these limitations, we propose a novel sparse regularized Hessian graph nonnegative low-rank matrix factorization (SHNMF) algorithm to mine the geometric structure and sparsity of data in mixed RFID signals. The L1/2 sparse is first implemented to constrain NMF algorithm to achieve sparse representation of RFID signals, and Hessian graph regularization terms is used capture the geometric and nonlinear characteristics of the data effectively. And then iterative update rule based on vertex component analysis and fully constrained least squares is adopted to optimize composite model. Finally, L<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1/2</sub>NMF and HNMF is compared with the proposed SHNMF for anti-collision performance, the simulated data verify that the proposed SHNMF achieves the highest signal-to-source ratio (SSR) and the lowest mean squared error (MSE). The proposed model shows a more effective signal blind separation performance and makes blind separation of RFID system greatly improved.

articleTitle: New media user behavior prediction and content recommendation based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: With the development of information age, mobile apps have penetrated into every aspect of modern people's life, accompanied by the explosion of user information, video information and product information. How people get the information they are interested in, and how apps and web pages can push users more interesting content from massive data based on their browsing history and other relevant user characteristics have become popular research nowadays. In recent years, user click prediction models and recommendation models designed by combining deep neural networks have been far more effective than traditional machine learning models. With the explosive growth of data sets, effective processing of data information combined with neural network models has become the key to improve the effectiveness of the models. Therefore, in this paper, we improve and optimize the user behavior click-throughrates (CTR) prediction algorithm on apps/web pages by starting from the user click-throughrates (CTR) model in sparse scenarios. Finally, it is proved experimentally that verifying the feature interaction information is the key to the user click-through prediction model, which provides new ideas and methods for the design of the user click-through prediction model.

articleTitle: Research on attitude analysis and improvement of volleyball players based on machine vision
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: This article aims to analyze and improve the posture of volleyball players by using CNN (Convolutional neural network) in machine learning technology. Firstly, the paper constructs a deep learning model, which can extract key information from athletes' movements, and then classify and assess them. Secondly, this article collects a large number of volleyball match videos as training data, and provides sufficient posture data for the model through fine labeling. Finally, the accuracy and stability of the model are verified by experiments. The results show that the model can effectively classify the posture of volleyball players, and its classification accuracy rate is as high as 96%. This research is of great significance to improve the training level and competition performance of volleyball players. Coaches can accurately assess the posture of athletes through this model, and then make more scientific training plans. Moreover, athletes can also use this model to assess themselves and adjust their movements and state in time to improve their performance. This study also provides new ideas and methods for attitude evaluation of other sports.

articleTitle: Design and implementation of green building interior design style recommendation system based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: Information overload is very common in the era of big data, which has given rise to the rapid development of recommendation systems. With the rise of environmental consciousness, green building practices have become crucial. The traditional interior design industry, while being costly, often overlooks sustainable practices. This paper focuses on a deep learning-based hybrid recommendation model to infuse sustainability in interior designs. Using an interior design software platform, we intelligently recommend green building designs, ensuring both aesthetics and eco-friendliness.

articleTitle: Modeling and visualization analysis of industrial data mechanism based on artificial intelligence
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: Although the industrial internet of things can currently provide a large amount of training data for data-driven methods, these data have the defects of dispersion, limitation, high noise and potential homogeneity. A large amount of fault operating industrial data cannot be collected, and the measurable positions of sensors are extremely limited and the noise component is extremely high. At the same time, the current fully data-driven method lacks the modeling of physical systems, which makes it impossible for professionals to interpret these data, let alone use them efficiently, and the accuracy and reliability of the model are questionable. The mechanism + data fusion model can fully leverage the advantages of the mechanism model's strong interpretability and generalization ability, as well as the flexibility and learnability of the data-driven model by embedding physical mechanisms into the data-driven model. This article utilizes artificial intelligence to more efficiently combine limited capacity data and physical mechanisms in industry and proposes the use of partial least squares BP (PLS-BP) algorithm to establish a multi model mixed form data model and conduct online monitoring of material consumption and quality indicators in PTA production process. At the same time, this work constructed a real-time monitoring optimization system architecture diagram and completed visualization research. The experimental results show that the multi model hybrid modeling proposed in this paper has good performance in industrial production process monitoring.

articleTitle: An improved shrimp larvae counting algorithm based on HRNET
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: Modern computer science also plays a crucial role in Aquaculture, especially in utilizing computer vision and deep learning techniques to address identification and counting issues in shrimp farming. Accurate individual counting of shrimp fry is crucial for effective aquaculture management. However, traditional manual counting methods are time-consuming, labor-intensive, and prone to errors. Additionally, challenges such as mutual occlusion and varying lighting conditions in densely populated areas of shrimp fry can lead to inaccurate counting. In this paper, we propose the use of a High-Resolution Network (HRNET) to extract important information from images at multiple scales, mitigating information loss caused by external factors like lighting and overlapping due to mutual occlusion. By incorporating attention mechanisms, we enhance the feature representation of the backbone network for small targets, thereby improving recognition and counting accuracy. Furthermore, to address differences between dense and sparse regions, we employ dilated convolutions to expand the receptive field and replace the Mean Squared Error (MSE) loss, which solely focuses on pixel-level average errors, with the Dilated Multiscale Structural Similarity (DMS-SSIM) loss function that considers similarity in subtle image structures and quality. Experimental results demonstrate a significant improvement in both the Mean Absolute Error (MAE) and MSE.

articleTitle: Vibration signal-based fault prediction using few-shot learning in the digital twin ecosystem
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: The current era is the era of digital transformation. Various concepts such as Cyber-Physical Systems, digital twins, etc. are proposed to implement this transformation. A digital twin is a virtual replica that can monitor and predict the state of any asset or process enabling the use of various cutting-edge technologies. A digital twin has a variety of applications. Maintenance is one area where digital twins are actively used for predictive maintenance. To work efficiently a real time data collection mechanism is required. Also, it may not always feasible to capture and train large data sets for Machine learning models due to the cost and other limitations associated with it. In this paper, a digital twin is created using OPCUA server. Digital Twin captures the data from the IoT sensors with the help of various protocols. This data is intelligently analyzed with various machine learning algorithms built into the digital twin to monitor health status. Few-shot learning, an algorithm in which a machine learning model can learn with a limited amount of data and perform reasonably accurately is used. For this study, a rotary asset is explored for fault prediction. The vibration signals are converted into 2D images which are then trained on CNN models using the Siamese Neural Networks method. The performed analysis proven to be very effective in various fault classifications. The knowledge gained through few-shot learning remains with digital twins to monitor similar kinds of newly added assets without any much training.

articleTitle: Real-time binocular depth estimation for autonomous driving based on convolutional neural network
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: The relative distance to other vehicles on the road is one of the key data points that an autonomous driving camera system needs to acquire. Most of the related research has primarily focused on estimating depth distances using image sequences from stereo cameras to generate depth maps for entire images. To reduce the computational complexity of depth estimation and improve real-time capabilities, this study proposes a strategy that utilizes convolutional neural network (CNN) technology in conjunction with triangulation methods for estimating the depth distance of the measured object. Initially, the CNN network structure is tailored through cropping and trained to serve as a vehicle detection model. Subsequently, this model is applied to multiple frames from the stereo camera. Following this, relative distance between the object of interest and the host vehicle is estimated using histogram similarity estimation and triangulation calculations. To validate the effectiveness of this approach, extensive simulation test was conducted on an autonomous driving platform. Experimental results demonstrate that this method exhibits a certain degree of effectiveness, with depth estimation errors being kept within an acceptable range.

articleTitle: Analysis and design of networked motor control system based on bilateral closed-loop function approach
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: In the network environment with data transmission time lag, the study of the relationship between the time lag range and the maximum sampling period allowed to ensure system stability is of guiding significance for the design of practical network control systems. To this end, this paper investigates the sampling controller design problem in the network environment, and for the problem that the nonlinear term in the sampling controller calculation process cannot be solved, the parameter substitution method is used to linearise the problem, and the maximum sampling period of the sampling control system and the corresponding controller gain are derived under the uncertainty of the time lag. Considering the fact that the aging and loss of AC asynchronous motors in real situations may lead to uncertainty in the motor parameters. Therefore, the robust stability problem of networked AC asynchronous motor containing uncertain parameters is further investigated. The existence conditions of the H∞ controller are obtained in conjunction with the H∞ control theory, and the design method of the controller is proposed. The effectiveness of the method is verified by numerical examples and simulations.

articleTitle: Research on the effect of multiple jammers based on PCA algorithm
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: Artificial intelligence learning algorithms have become the mainstream way to analyze data, and combining related algorithms with military research is of great help to the construction of national defense forces. In recent years, the rapid development of radar electronic countermeasures technology has posed a great challenge to missile penetration. Traditional passive jamming can not meet the need of penetration. By studying the joint suppression of enemy radar by multiple jammers in airspace during penetration, the enemy radar system can be effectively jammed. Based on Principal Component Analysis(PCA) algorithm and the current research status of spatial distribution of jammers, this paper relies on spatial distribution criteria, coordinate system theory and jamming suppression theory to discuss the influence of multi-jammer joint jamming suppression, and to model and simulate the influence of different spatial distribution characteristics of jammers on radars with different effects. The theory and idea are verified by matlab simulation, the image dimension is reduced by PCA algorithm, and the influence of different distributed jammers on the enemy radar is compared, and the influence of different distributed jammers on the enemy radar exposure area is obtained.

articleTitle: Research on power grid contract entity and relation extraction based on domain embedding
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: Power grid contracts have complex structures and domain specific entity relationships, posing challenges to natural language processing models. This paper proposes a BERT BiLSTM CRF entity and relationship extraction model based on domain embedd ing to better capture relevant entities and relationship information in power grid contract texts. Firstly, we construct a domain embedding matrix based on contract text information, generate word vectors representing contextual semantic information throug h the BERT preprocessing model, and add domain embedding vectors to the output of BERT. The generated vectors are then feature extracted through BiLSTM, and the entity relationship sequence is decoded through CRF. The purpose of this paper is to improve th e accuracy of the model's extraction of entity relationships in power grid contracts through domain embedding, laying the foundation for subsequent contract text standardization, risk prediction, and intelligent review. Experiments have proven that the mod el can effectively identify entities and relationships in power grid contracts.

articleTitle: Simulation research on single joint control of day-lily manipulator based on error sign integral robust control
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: In this paper, the kinematics and dynamics of this day-lily manipulator are analyzed, and the kinematics and single joint dynamics are modeled. A single joint control algorithm for day-lily manipulator based on Error sign integral robust with Expanded state observer (RISE-ESO) was proposed. The expanded observer is used to observe and suppress the error, and the error sign integral robust controller is designed by using the backstepping method, and the Lyapunov stability is verified. The designed controller was simulated and compared with the traditional PID controller, and the tracking effect and tracking error were observed respectively when there was no interference and when there was interference. The results show that, compared with PID controller, the RISE-ESO controller has better tracking effect. Regardless of whether there is interference or not, the maximum error of single joint Angle controlled by the RISE-ESO controller is much smaller than that of PID controller, and compared with PID controller, the RISE-ESO controller has better anti-interference. It can be applied to single joint control of manipulator.

articleTitle: CPPM: a container power prediction method based on performance counters
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: With the development and advancement of cloud computing, the deployment of user applications in data centers using containers have become increasingly common. In the operation and maintenance process of modern data centers, more and more attention is paid to low-carbon environmental protection and high energy efficiency. Fine-grained monitoring of container power is an important content of data center energy efficiency management. However, the power sensors provided by the hardware can only provide the overall power at the server level, which will cause us to obtain power information at a very coarse power granularity. In order to obtain fine-grained power information at the container level, we propose a container power prediction method based on performance counters. First, we train a neural network model for container power prediction, and then we input the performance counters information when the container is running into the model to predict the container power. Experimental results demonstrate that our proposed model can effectively predict container power.

articleTitle: Study on multi-parameter of cold spraying technology via RSM and BP+GA methods
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: Cold spraying (CS) technology is a new way to form coatings by solid-state deposition, which is widely used in aviation, aerospace, Marine, and biological fields. Because of the diversity of cold spraying technical parameters, the influence of multiple factors on the powder collision velocity is to be studied. The response surface method (RSM) and BP neural network + genetic algorithm(BP+GA) are introduced for multi-parameter optimization of the CS technology, aiming to obtain the optimal value of the target. Take powder size, gas temperature, and gas pressure as independent variables and nozzle outlet velocity as dependent variables. Hence, it established a three-factor and three-level response surface mathematical model. BP+GA was used to compare, discuss, and verify the optimized results. It shows that both the RSM and BP+GA optimization methods are feasible, and the error values are 0.4% and 4.4%, respectively. It provides an effective process parameter optimization method for the cold spray technology field for reference by relevant workers.

articleTitle: Implementing disease early warning based on machine learning algorithms
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: In order to improve the prediction accuracy of breast cancer, a machine learning hybrid model based on integration idea was proposed. Firstly, the decision tree and Logistic regression (LR) algorithm models are used to predict breast cancer respectively to judge whether breast cancer is malignant. And the prediction accuracy, accuracy, recall, and F1-score are used as indicators to evaluate the performance of the model. Using the area under the receiver operating characteristic (ROC) curve (AUC), accuracy, sensitivity and specificity to evaluate the prediction ability of machine learning, the experimental results show that the prediction accuracy of the mixed model in predicting the effect of breast cancer reaches 98.2%, which effectively improves the ability of breast cancer to be correctly identified, and can provide a basis for patients to formulate follow-up treatment strategies.

articleTitle: Bayesian sampling method design based on hierarchical model
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: Bayesian sampling methods based on Hierarchical models Bayesian analysis methods are commonly used to estimate and infer the parameters of hierarchical models. In this paper, a sampling method based on the three-stage Bayesian hierarchical model is proposed by combining the relationship between layers and the posterior estimation of hierarchical Bayes. In the first stage, the data is modeled as a function with unknown parameters. In the second stage, after taking into account the covariate information, each parameter is assigned some form of distribution. In the Bayesian model, a third stage is required, specifying prior distributions for all parameters that define the distribution form of the second stage and the variance-covariance matrix. Based on Bayesian Maximum a posteriori estimation (MAPB) and the complete Bayes Markov Chain Monte Carlo (MCMC) algorithm are combined to solve it. The results show that the MCMC algorithm converges, and the model is well fitted and has good prediction ability.

articleTitle: Development study on artificial intelligence target detection technology with ant colony optimization
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: In single-objective optimization, the ant colony optimization is a relatively common problem. Since there is only one objective function, the restriction is usually lifted to a specific range. However, this algorithm will fail if the optimization objective is not chosen rationally. Therefore, in this paper, the number of objective functions has been increased by combining the ant colony optimization with the artificial intelligence objective detection technique. According to the multi-objective strategy, the multi-objective ACO algorithm is proposed, and this algorithm is able to generate a set of optimal solutions of Pareto during the operation, especially in three real-world networks, which verifies the effectiveness and accuracy of this algorithm.

articleTitle: MySQL data analysis and its application in E-commerce user behavior analysis
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: MySQL is a free open source database management system of Oracle Corporation. In enterprises, MySQL can manage all kinds of data in the operation of enterprises, instead of traditional manual operation to deal with enterprise related information, greatly improve the efficiency of enterprise information processing, greatly meet the information management needs of small, medium and large enterprises. Data analysis is a kind of behavior to turn the massive and unclear data into regular and effective data that can extract useful information. Data analysis not only provides descriptive analysis of data, but also predictive analysis and decision making solutions. Data analysis is of great value for both personal applications and commercial enterprises. In this paper, we use MySQL, Tableau, Excel software tools and AARRR model, funnel model and RFM model to analyze user activity, user retention rate, product conversion rate and user value of online shopping platform user behavior to summarize user behavior data and make rationalization suggestions for the platform. The research results of this paper have certain reference significance for enterprises to invest human and material resources reasonably and create greater sales profits in the future.

articleTitle: Data statistics acceleration calculation method based on massive measuring point scene in industrial field
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: Energy measurement in the industrial field requires hierarchical measurement and statistics of all links in the energy use process, which is not only large in data scale, but also requires high real time performance. Based on the actual background of the above massive measurement points in the industrial Internet of Things field, a hierarchical accelerated calculation method based on statistical data is proposed, which solves the problems of traditional calculation methods such as long time consumption, large system resources occupation, and inability to meet large scale scene applications. Through the practical application in an industrial system in Hunan, it is found that the accelerated statistical calculation method reduces the statistical calculation time by more than three times, and improves the statistical calculation efficiency. In addition, the computational speed of the algorithm can increase linearly with the number of computing centers allocated.

articleTitle: Design of weld recognition system based on machine vision
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: With the rapid progress and innovation of computer vision, image processing and other related disciplines and theoretical methods, machine vision has been more and more widely used. In the process of welding production, there are many kinds of weld defects, such as crack, incomplete penetration, incomplete fusion, porosity and slag inclusion, which affect the quality of parts. The traditional weld defect recognition generally relies on the visual inspection of professional workers, which is inefficient and has a high rate of missed detection, which seriously affects the recognition of defect images. Aiming at this problem, this paper comprehensively discusses the key technologies of weld image processing, weld defect recognition, defect target detection and so on. On this basis, a new weld defect recognition method-target detection method based on image edge detection is proposed, and a weld defect recognition system is designed accordingly. Firstly, the concept and principle of machine vision are introduced, and OpenCV open source vision library is selected as the development platform. Secondly, the basic process of weld defect recognition is analyzed, and the key technologies are studied and analyzed, and compared with the same type of technology. Then, a weld recognition system based on machine vision is designed. Through data analysis and image processing, common weld defects can be automatically identified. Finally, a variety of weld defects were identified to verify the feasibility of the system.

articleTitle: Reconstruction-based time series anomaly detection on contaminated data
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: Time series anomaly detection(TSAD) aims to find abnormal segments in sequences. There have been many methods are proposed for time series anomaly detection, including reconstruction-based and prediction-based methods. Previous reconstruction-based time series anomaly detection models are implicitly trained to perform poorly on anomalies, so that anomalies will stand out in residuals. But some unexpected fitting issues may allow the models to still reconstruct anomalies well in time series. For example, the default no-anomaly assumption of the training set in previous researches may make the models fit the hidden anomalies, causing a degraded detection sensitivity. Toward a more rigorous detection, we innovatively introduce the Drop-Loss to unsupervised eliminate possible anomalous losses during training to block the backpropagation of abnormal gradients, thereby avoiding unexpected fitting. The proposed method is validated on four benchmarks with extensive experiments and achieve state-of-the-art results.

articleTitle: The research and design of electrical engineering experiments auxiliary instruction system with speech recognition
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: In the traditional electrical engineering experiment teaching scenarios, there are shortcomings such as the lack of experiment instructors for the complicated steps of experiments, resulting lack of detailed guidance to all students. In order to addres s th e issue, this paper introduces speech recognition technology into the electrical experiment teaching scenarios and improves the recognition accuracy of speech recognition under noise environment with the improved MFCC speech recognition algorithm. By testing the accuracy of speech recognition under different noise conditions, it is shown that compared with the traditional speech recognition algorithm, the improved speech recognition algorithm achieves the best recognition rate when the signal to noise ratio is 15 dB, and even when the signal to noise ratio is 5 dB, the recognition rate is also improved by 20% on average. The research in this paper provides an application reference of the artificial intelligence application in electrical experiment assisted instruction.

articleTitle: Human action recognition on campus monitor by integrating non-local attention mechanism
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: Campus serves as the primary location for students to engage in both study and living, hence it is crucial to guarantee the safety of students during any activities carried out on campus. The use of video surveillance for the automatic identification of student activities is an efficient approach to enhance security management. This paper presents a neural network model that incorporates a non-local attention mechanism to analyze human action in a campus environment. The model is pre-trained on public datasets and then trained and tested on self-built scenario datasets for the campus. The experiment compared the differences between having an attention mechanism versus not having one, as well as the impact of the location of the attention module insertion on the results. Meanwhile, we compared it with other public methods. The results showed that the model in this paper was able to effectively identify behavioral categories in surveillance videos, achieving an accuracy rate of 91. 5 %, an improvement of 4. 3 percentage points over the baseline model. This article provides an improvement approach for identifying student behavior activities in campus settings, and to some extent contributes to improving campus safety.

articleTitle: Application of PID parameter tuning for robots based on SIMULINK
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: Nowadays, more and more primary and secondary school students like to participate in technology activities, especially in robot competitions. In robot competitions, students mainly control robot movements, complete tasks specified in the project, and ultimately evaluate based on their level of completion and points earned. Controlling the accuracy of robot motion is a challenge, and directly using control voltage to control robot motion is no longer sufficient for current tasks. More and more teams are using PID control method, and compared with ordinary methods, it is found that using PID control has better results, but its PID parameter tuning is a difficulty. In response to the complexity of the PID parameter tuning process, taking PID parameter tuning based on the SIMULINK environment as an example, by establishing a mathematical model of motor speed, studying the PID parameter tuning process, and using the SIMULINK environment, adjusting the control slider can freely modify the PID parameters, Moreover, it can adjust robots with different loads in a timely manner, saving a lot of work time, which is of great significance in practical applications and control theory.

articleTitle: Design and research of household intelligent classified garbage bin based on machine vision
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: Due to the lack of understanding of the concept of garbage classification and the lack of awareness of garbage classification in the process of garbage classification, a home intelligent sorting trash bin design based on machine vision is proposed based on these problems. The garbage sorting device, combined with the mechanical structure, proposes a garbage bin design using the Raspberry Pi system. The structure design of the intelligent trash bin composed of Raspberry Pi development board, Raspberry Pi camera, LED light, servo and independent four warehouses are given, and the design ideas of the trash bin in the realization process are expounded. The overall framework design of the system consists of image acquisition module, image processing module, four modules including garbage classification and control module, focusing on the application of image processing in garbage classification, improving the accuracy and processing efficiency of household garbage classification.

articleTitle: A fault diagnosis online method of railway track based on knowledge transfer learning
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: In the complex environment of actual train operation, due to the lack of railway track fault sample data, the fault diagnosis online model cannot be directly established. However, under the environment of track inspection vehicle and actual train operation, the railway track has the same health status space and most fault types. Therefore, this paper proposes a railway track fault diagnosis online method based on knowledge transfer learning. First, the railway track fault data under the track inspection vehicle environment is taken as the source domain, and the fault data is processed as knowledge and rules, and the expert knowledge rule base based on Belief Rule Base reasoning (BRB) is established. Then, the noise distribution of actual train operation is simulated by triangular distribution, and the fault space of railway track in complex environment is obtained as the target domain. Finally, the knowledge rules in the source domain are transferred to the target domain, and a three-level iterative optimization transfer weight learning method is designed to realize the accurate diagnosis of railway track online fault. The effectiveness of the proposed method is verified by experiments.

articleTitle: Visual sensor aided by image processing based on optimization algorithm research of mobile robot localization
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of artificial intelligence technology, intelligent robots have become a popular research object in academia and industry. An indoor autonomous mobile robot must face three main problems: where am I, where am I going, and how do I get there. Among them, the "where am I" localization problem is particularly important. This paper focuses on a vision-based multi-sensor fusion indoor localization scheme, which is based on binocular vision and fuses wheeled ranging and IMU, and proposes a high accuracy, high robustness and low cost multi-sensor fusion vision SLAM scheme based on ranging and IMU fusion, with pose update assisted vision ranging at the front end and graphics optimization at the back end. Finally, the shortcomings of traditional vision SLAM algorithms that rely too much on image information are compensated by the optimization and improvement of the algorithms. The EKF algorithm is used to combine the robotic wheeled ranger with the I MU's pose information-assisted vision program as a precursor to the SLAM algorithm. Finally, localization accuracy experiments and localization robustness experiments are conducted, which prove that the algorithm proposed in this paper has high localization accuracy and robustness.

articleTitle: A machine learning fusion algorithm for identifying rainfall enhancement potential areas
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: Using the 2005-2020 stratified precipitation cloud system aircraft operation detection data, ground observation data and ERA5 reanalysis data in Inner Mongolia, we use a variety of machine learning algorithms to discuss the applicability of machine learning methods in the prediction of rainfall enhancement potential areas, and build a multi-machine learning fusion model. The results show that the machine learning algorithm can effectively identify seeding areas and non-seeding areas of artificial rain. The fusion model constructed by combining the prediction results of CatBoost, extra tree and random forest algorithms has obtained the optimal prediction effect, and its TS score on the test set is higher than that of any algorithm alone. The probability of detection, false negative rate and false alarm rate of the fusion model are 84.21%, 4% and 15.78%, respectively, and the TS score is 0.8136.

articleTitle: Path optimization problem analysis based on improved ant colony algorithm
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: Ant colony algorithm is a swarm intelligence algorithm that combines positive feedback principle and heuristic algorithm , It can be used to search for the optimal path , which has the characteristics of less dependence on initial value selection and strong robustness. The traditional ant colony algorithm has the drawbacks of slow convergence speed and falling into local optima easily during computation. In order to avoid the above defects , The paper proposes an improved ant colony algorithm by segmenting the pheromone volatile factor. As the number of iterations increases , the algorithm's glob al search ability is enhanced by adjusting the size of the pheromone volatile factor. Combining the latitude and longitude coordinates of 32 famous tourist attractions distributed throughout China , We apply them to the path optimization problem and conduct comparative analysis. Matlab simulation calculation results indicate that the improved ant colony algorithm has faster convergence speed and stronger robustness , which can be widely applied to path planning problems and has broad practical application sig nificance.

articleTitle: Study on the detection method of driver's fatigue based on machine vision
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: Traffic accident is still an important social problem, and fatigue detection is an important way to solve the problem of fatigue driving. How to pass the non-contact, does not affect the normal driving fatigue detection technology is now a hot spot in the field of automobile fatigue diagnosis. Based on machine vision, this paper provides a method of detecting driver fatigue state. This method collects images wh0en drivers driving by non-contact method. Homomorphic filtering algorithm and Histogram equalization method are used to process each frame to reduce the influence of uneven illumination and enhance the contrast of the image. By detecting human face images, locating the position of human eyes, processing the human eye images, analyzing the state of the human eyes in time, and calculating the "fatigue value" through the PERCLOS standard, the driver's fatigue state can be judged. Experimental results show that this method is a high-precision, non-contact, real-time driver fatigue state detection method.

articleTitle: Research on image recognition method and personalized recommendation model based on deep learning
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: In response to the problems of low accuracy and poor user experience caused by cold start and incomplete consideration of user timing preferences in traditional recommendation systems, the article proposes an image recognition method and personalized recommendation model based on deep learning. The model is based on a short-term and short-term memory network model, first extracting keywords from user behavior item features, and establishing feature vectors between user behavior and images; Then, the feature vectors of user behavior and images are sorted in chronological order to obtain a list of user interest points. Then, feature maps and cosine similarity are used to calculate the similarity between images, and the target user's preference for different feature keywords is obtained, providing a data basis for personalized recommendations; finally, by repeatedly adjusting the training parameters through the constructed deep training model, a more accurate recommendation list is obtained. The recommendation algorithm is linearly combined with image similarity to provide personalized recommendations for users. Obtaining test data through the internet, identifying selected images, obtaining personalized recommendation lists through recognition results, and comparing them with traditional methods. After comparative analysis, the proposed image recognition method has higher recommendation accuracy compared to the recommendation model.

articleTitle: NLP based on prompt-based learning and prompting methods: a survey
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: In this survey paper, we attempted to summarize the recent work of a paradigm shift in the natural processing language field that we call "Prompt-based learning". In recent years, the rapid development and stability of pre-trained language models have driven the advancement of this novel approach. Prompt-based learning leverages language models for clue-driven learning and has made significant strides in the field of natural language processing. To make predictions, the process begins with the design of text prompts based on the nature of the task and input-output format. Subsequently, user input data is combined with these text prompts to create a new text sequence, which is then fed into a pre-trained language model. Following this, information required for the task is extracted or interpreted from the generated text, and ultimately, the interpreted results are presented to the user or used for further processing, depending on the task requirements. However, there is currently no standardized framework for prompt-based learning. Existing code libraries for prompt-based learning are typically unregulated and provide limited functionality tailored to specific scenarios. Therefore, this paper aims to elucidate the theoretical foundations, various mathematical approaches, and existing research methodologies, as well as key aspects such as model selection, prompt optimization processes, and practical applications of prompt-based learning.

articleTitle: Intelligent picking robot for orchard based on visual recognition
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: With the continuous improvement of the level of agricultural mechanization, intelligent fruit picking in orchards has become one of the hotspots in the field of agricultural automation. Traditional manual picking is labor intensive and inefficient, unable to meet the growing demand for fruit. This study aims to design an orchard intelligent picking robot based on visual recognition tec hnology, to achieve automatic fruit detection, positioning, and picking, thereby improving the efficiency of orchard harvesti ng. The system uses a depth camera for visual collection of fruit and utilizes convolutional neural networks to classify and reco gn ize different fruits. The robotic arm is controlled based on the fruit's positional information for precise picking. Experimental results show that the system has over 90% accuracy in recognizing various fruits and can precisely locate and complete the pic king task, tripling the efficiency compared to manual picking. This system is expected to solve the current shortage of labor in orchard picking and enhance the efficiency of harvesting. It can also implement individual fruit tracking management, laying th e foundation for precise sales and cultivation. Future improvements can be made in fruit classification recognition and robotic arm control technology, extending its application to other crop picking fields and promoting the process of digital and intellig ent agriculture.

articleTitle: Research on automated review method for harmful information of smart device
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: As an important information exchange platform, smart device applications are generating a huge amount of multimedia data anytime and anywhere, the harmful information in the data will endanger the physical and mental health of users. In response to this issue, the paper proposes an automated review method for harmful information from smart device applications, which can review and rate the content interacted with smart device applications, thereby grading the applications, identifying the applications that affect the physical and mental health of users, and extracting all detected harmful content as evidence, and then saving it in the abnormality report. For multimodal content, this paper also proposes a new multimodal fusion algorithm for the fusion of multimodal content, which facilitates the rating and review of applications content. The results have shown that by rating and reviewing multimodal fusion content, the harmful information from applications can be well distinguished, thereby protecting the physical and mental health of users.

articleTitle: Air-ground collaborative network coverage enhancement algorithm based on power grid and deep learning
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: Mainstream power communication methods can no longer meet the growing communication needs of the power industry. Airborne networks can significantly improve wireless coverage and network capacity, and it can meet the communication needs of the power industry in cities with different population densities. However, the coverage capacity is severely affected by the limited energy of the over-the-air network. Therefore, how to significantly enhance the coverage performance of airborne base stations with limited range time is a key issue. Based on this, we deeply analyze the characteristics of the power grid scenario and establish an air-ground collaborative network architecture to meet the application of the power grid scenario. And then, we analyze the air-ground collaborative network coverage performance optimization problem, and we first transform the coverage enhancement problem into a highly dynamic deployment problem of air-ground network base stations. We propose a deep learning-based coverage enhancement algorithm for air-ground collaborative networks, and we fully consider coverage energy efficiency and time efficiency in the design of the reward function. Furthermore, we utilize a collaborative approach between ground and air networks to continuously optimize and adjust the highly dynamic deployment strategy of air network base stations, thus enhancing the air collaborative network coverage performance. Simulation experimental results show that the algorithm we proposed consistently achieves higher coverage efficiency compared to the sequential service algorithm, and it significantly improves coverage efficiency compared to other mainstream algorithms.

articleTitle: A study on the improvement of K-means algorithm based on community discovery
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: The k-means algorithm, as one of the top ten classical data mining algorithms, has been widely used in various fields due to its high efficiency since it was proposed. However, with the deep development of the Internet, the data on the network is growing explosively, which makes the efficiency of k-means algorithm face challenges in big data scenarios. In this paper, the k-means algorithm is used to realize the clustering of text with similar topics by calculating the similarity between text topics. For the shortcomings of the k-means algorithm, an improved k-means algorithm based on community discovery is proposed to determine the optimal number of clusters and the initial clustering center through community discovery and the center node selection method in the community, and the effectiveness of the proposed improved method is verified through experiments. Finally, it is verified through experiments that the improved k-means algorithm effectively enhances the clustering speed, and the same time improves the clustering quality in terms of the F-measure value, which provides a reference for massive text categorization.

articleTitle: Impacts of data preprocessing and TF-IDF based feature extraction on chinese spam recognition in machine learning methods
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: Spam has been threatening people's life and production safety, in order to reduce its harm, it is necessary to study the topic of spam filtering. In spam identification, data preprocessing and feature extraction are two important aspects. In this paper, the impact of combing TF-IDF (Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency) based feature extraction and different preprocessing methods on Chinese spam recognition is investigated. We analyzed the effectiveness of mainstream machine learning methods on Chinese spam identification with or without data preprocessing. We discussed in detail the effect of different sizes of features on the classification results. The SVM (Support Vector Machine) model presented in this paper achieves very high accuracy (99.0%) and F1 (99.26%) value in spam filtering. It shows that data preprocessing improves the performance of machine learning models, and the degree of improvement is related to the selected model. Experiments have shown that to achieve the same accuracy, the random forest model requires fewer features than the Bayesian model.

articleTitle: A data encryption scheme combined symmetric encryption algorithm with asymmetric encryption algorithm
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: In order to explore the research of computer network data security encryption technology. The author proposes a data encryption scheme that combines symmetric encryption algorithms with asymmetric encryption algorithms, by combining AES algorithm with RSA algorithm and ECC algorithm, improved hybrid encryption algorithms AES-RSA and AES-ECC are obtained. In order to verify the correctness of the scheme, a Hadoop experimental platform was built and tested using Hadoop Eclipse, the time required for different algorithms to encrypt the same size of data was measured. Through the analysis of the obtained experimental data and the safety of the experimental plan, the experimental results indicate that, the AES-RSA algorithm takes slightly longer to encrypt the same data than the AES-ECC algorithm, this is because in these two hybrid encryption algorithms, the RSA algorithm defaults to using a 1024 bit key, while the ECC algorithm selects a key length of 160 bits. A 160 bit ECC key can provide security equivalent to a 1024 bit RSA key, so based on the advantage of small key bits, under the same security strength, the AES-ECC algorithm has higher encryption efficiency than the AES-RSA algorithm. It has been proven that the improved encryption algorithm has the advantages of efficiency and high security, and can achieve secure storage of data in cloud computing environments.

articleTitle: Enhancing multiple information extraction with comprehensive augmentation strategies leveraging a text generation model
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: Information extraction is a vital component of natural language processing, involved in extracting structured data from unstructured text. Considerable efforts have been dedicated to developing advanced approaches aimed at enhancing the performance of multiple information extraction tasks, particularly focusing on scenarios where multiple groups of information must be extracted from a single paragraph. One primary challenge is the scarcity of annotated training data, particularly across diverse domains. To comprehensively address this challenge, this paper proposes three robust data augmentation strategies that significantly enhances both the diversity and quantity of the training data. The methodology combines Numeric Variation, Sentence-Level Augmentation, and Token-Level Augmentation techniques, all integrated into a text generation model. Extensive experiments are conducted on a purposefully designed real-world dataset that accurately reflects the challenges associated with extracting multiple groups of information from a single paragraph. The results exhibit a significant enhancement in performance across diverse information extraction domains.

articleTitle: Method for detection of traffic signal lights based on improved YOLOV5
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: Aiming at the problems of difficult detection and low accuracy of traditional traffic light detection algorithms in practical applications, a traffic light detection algorithm based on improved YOLOv5 is proposed. This method integrates Transformer and CBAM modules into the YOLOv5 framework to further improve the detection performance of traffic lights. The Transformer module helps the model to enhance the attention to the target, especially the recognition of traffic lights in complex environments. CBAM helps to enhance the model's response to different signal light colors, thereby improving the recognition accuracy of traffic signal light colors. The improved algorithm introduces the backbone part of the YOLOv5 model into the encoder structure of the Transformer, replaces the self-attention module with the convolution layer of the Transformer, and adds the CBAM module after each stage. By increasing the attention mechanism, the feature extraction ability of the environment is enhanced. The experimental results on the BDD dataset and the self-built dataset show that the improved algorithm improves the accuracy rate by 8.8%, compared with YOLOv5 s. In this study, ablation experiments and comparative experiments of different algorithms were carried out. The results show that the improved algorithm has a significant improvement in detection speed and accuracy, and basically meets the requirements of complex traffic light detection in practical applications.

articleTitle: Based on atrous spatial convolutional and attention mechanism cycle-consistent generative adversarial defogging network
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of poor de-fogging effect caused by incomplete prior knowledge of atmospheric scattering model and lack of actual paired image data set in image de-fogging method, a cycle-consistent generative adversarial network based on convolution and attention modules of void space is proposed for image defogging. The unsupervised defogging of unpaired images is completed by using the constrained transfer learning ability and cyclic structure of cycle-consistent generative adversarial network. Considering the serious detail loss of the target object and the complexity of fog distribution in actual imaging, combined with the real visual features, the common convolution is replaced by the empty space convolution ASPP module, the attention module CBAM is integrated into the network to realize the non-homogenization of different features and different regions. The experimental results show that the proposed method has better results on both the synthetic image data set and the real fog data set.

articleTitle: Research on key technologies for electric power system measurement index selection based on SMOTE algorithm
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: For the selection of measurement indicators in the power system, this article adopts the SMOTE algorithm. The SMOTE algorithm is a popular oversampling algorithm that modifies random sampling by artificially synthesizing samples be tween minority class samples through interpolation, increasing the number of minority class samples. The key technologies for measuring indicators mainly include data cleaning, data sampling, and data transformation. some key technical issues in the proces s of establishing a machine learning model for power system evaluation are studied, including data cleaning of raw data and improving data quality: sampling is used to increase the proportion of instable samples in the power system evaluation sample concen tration, prevent model overfitting and merge, and improve model performance; The selection of input features was studied: the data was transformed before training the model to speed up the convergence of the model. The above method is verified in the New E ngland 10 machine 39 node study system, and the test results show that the proposed method is beneficial to the improvement of model performance to different degrees.

articleTitle: Random noise suppression of seismic data with generative adversarial network
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: Due to the complex nature of the seismic exploration environment, there is a significant amount of noise in the data gathering process, resulting in various factors that can affect the quality of the data. Standard denoising techniques and models are often insufficient in meeting the demand for high-quality seismic data. However, with the advancement of artificial intelligence, Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) has emerged as an effective solution for seismic data denoising. The GAN-based algorithm for random noise reduction in seismic data involves a generator and discriminator. The generator uses noisy seismic data as input to produce denoised data, while the discriminator evaluates the authenticity of the data. Through game training between the generator and discriminator, this method has been proven to successfully remove random noise from synthetic seismic data. Furthermore, experiments comparing this method to the conventional CNN method on real seismic data using evaluation indices such as data visualization and signal-to-noise ratio have demonstrated its effectiveness. This method shows great potential for future research and application in seismic data denoising.

articleTitle: Research on robot path planning based on artificial potential field method
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: With the arrival of the new era, computer technology has also developed rapidly on the basis of electronic technology. The development of these technologies usually also supports the development and application of artificial intelligence technology. For example, applying artificial intelligence technology to the field of robot action path planning. In order to solve the problems of low efficiency and path errors encountered in robot path planning, this paper proposes a research method for robot path planning based on artificial potential field method.
