This method first constructs an environment map on a two-dimensional plane based on the motion environment of the robot, which includes all obstacle points and free points; Then, based on the principle of artificial potential field algorithm, the MATLAB software environment is used for programming to implement the artificial potential field algorithm model; Then set the relevant program running parameters to make the algorithm model run; Finally, two-dimensional and three-dimensional visualization charts are used to display the combined forces, midway search process, costs, and paths during the planning process. After 749 iterative searches, the system has planned a reasonable red path that meets the expected requirements and can be promoted for use.

articleTitle: Analysis and optimization of localization error for personnel search and rescue based on unmanned aerial vehicle equipped with 5G single base station
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: Unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) are capable of covering vast areas, especially those that are challenging or hazardous for human access. As such, they have been increasingly utilized and advocated for in the search and rescue field. Theirapplication has facilitated more efficient and prompt responses and rescues. In this study, a UAV equipped with a 5G single base station and GPS positioning device was utilized for air- ground emergency search and rescue operations, in which Time Advance (TA), User Equipment identity, and Time Stamp data were gathered from the ground 5G terminal during flight. The current paper analyzes the inaccuracies that resulted from the fundamental data and proposes a time stamp alignment optimization procedure which relied on GPS raw data and the fundamental positioning data in accordance with the error analysis. Using the TOA positioning algorithm, we conducted a simulation experiment at different times and locations. The outcome was remarkable, demonstrating an improvement in the accuracy and efficacy of personnel search and rescue under the 5G single base station, by increasing the precision of the calculated position after time stamp error modification.

articleTitle: Mechanical system PID simulation based on simulink
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: In recent years, the continuous development of computer control related technologies has led people to consider whether these automatic control technologies can be integrated into the current control object when solving problems. For example, the classic PID (Proposal Integration Difference) control algorithm. In order to solve the problems of slow response and poor stability in mechanical system control, this article proposes a Simulink based PID simulation method for mechanical systems. This method first establishes a mathematical model (i.e. the transfer function of the system) based on various physical and chemical principles for the mechanical system; Next, PID control technology is applied to the transfer function of the system, and a control model is built using Simulink; Then, adjust the proportional, integral and differential coefficients adjusted by the PID regulator attached to the PID control model of the system; Finally, the coefficients are applied to the model to obtain the actual error, adjustment error, and actual output simulation waveform. After analysis and adjustment, the waveform can meet the control requirements of the system. This method can start from the transfer function stage and output the final simulation results, providing a practical and simple method for solving similar problems.

articleTitle: Design of an intelligent reminder system based on EEG monitoring
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: EEG waves reflect the synchronized firing of neurons in the brain, and different waveform patterns are associated with different cognitive states, such as attention, relaxation, or sleep. In this paper, we design an intelligent reminder system based on EEG monitoring. The process of system involves several steps, including pre-processing, filtering, artifact removal, feature extraction, and classification. Preprocessing involves removing any artifacts or noise from the raw EEG signal. Filtering is used to remove unwanted frequencies or amplify desired frequencies. Artifact removal techniques include independent component analysis and template matching, which can identify and remove artifacts such as eye blinks or heartbeats. Feature extraction algorithms aim to extract significant information from the processed signal. Classification algorithms are then used to classify the extracted features into specific categories, such as cognitive states, diseases, or mental tasks. Commonly used classification algorithms include support vector machines, neural networks, and linear discriminant analysis. EEG collection can potentially have an effect on reminding fatigue driving, as it may increase drivers' awareness of their cognitive states and alert them to signs of fatigue. By monitoring the electrical activity of the brain, EEG can provide real-time feedback on changes in cognitive states, such as decreased attention or increased drowsiness.

articleTitle: Design and research of UAV maritime search and rescue system based on multi-source information fusion
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: In recent years, marine activities such as marine fishing, inshore engineering, and marine surveying have increased day by day, and marine traffic conditions have become more and mor e complex. Shipwrecks occur from time to time, and the risk of collision is also increasing. In order to solve this problem, this paper proposes the design of a maritime UAV search and rescue system based on multi source information fusion. First of all, t he overall design of the target recognition and positioning of the UAV is carried out. In addition, it flies through a predetermined trajectory, and at the same time uses the on board camera to search for those who have fallen into the water in real time a nd transmits the image to the monitoring center. The drone can fly while looking for whether there are smart devices that can be worn around it. If there are, it will pass the collected information to the monitoring room, and then throw these things out un der someone's order. The monitoring center focused on the full situation of the people who fell into the water and the unmanned aircraft, and completed the centralized control of the search and rescue work through quick button commands. The results show th at the UAV search and rescue system using multi source information fusion can greatly improve the search and rescue rate.

articleTitle: A sequential recommendation algorithm combining attributes and long-term and short-term preferences
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: In recent years, sequence recommendation has played an important role in solving information overload problems in many online services.Most of the existing sequential recommendation methods focus on the dynamic preferences in the time series of user interaction, and ignore the long-term preferences of users and the characteristics and attributes of users and projects, which limit the recommendation ability.To solve these problems, a novel sequential recommendation algorithm CASLRec is proposed in this paper, that incorporates both long-term and short-term preference and attribute information. This model embedded the user and the item into the vector respectively and added multi-head self-attention mechanism to extract the deeper connection between items from the order pattern of users. At the same time, considering the long-term and short-term preference of users with various weights assigned, it took the embedding of similar users as a supplement to enhance the user representation. At the same time, in order to improve the performance of recommendation, the embedded learning deeply integrates user and project attribute information to simulate user interaction more comprehensively. Experiment results show that the proposed algorithm on ML-100K, ML-1M, and ML-HetRec datasets is superior than other baseline models on HR@50 and MRR.

articleTitle: New methods for VR rehabilitation intervention for children with cerebral palsy based on artificial intelligence
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: With the advancement of technology, the application of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in the field of medicine and rehabilitation is becoming increasingly widespread. However, how to effectively use these advanced technologies to improve rehabilitation outcomes remains an unresolved issue. This paper proposes a new AI-based VR rehabilitation method, providing new possibilities for the rehabilitation of children with cerebral palsy (CP). For this, the author studied the relevant literature and evaluated the latest Virtual Reality (VR) technology applications in CP rehabilitation interventions. In this context, the direction of development of VR rehabilitation applications was systematically analysed, and the interventional role of VR games in rehabilitation was deeply explored. Preliminary observations show that in VR rehabilitation interventions aided by AI, it may be more easily accepted by children with CP, and to a certain extent, can increase interest and compliance in the rehabilitation process. However, the application of VR technology in CP rehabilitation is still facing challenges in terms of technology and quantitative evaluation. Therefore, the author has constructed an AI-guided VR game evaluation system based on the children's movements, language, and vision to address these challenges and promote CP rehabilitation research for children.

articleTitle: Design of bolt defect recognition system based on machine vision
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: With the rapid development of artificial intelligence, machine vision, one of its application fields, has received extensive attention. Applying it to the manufacturing process has become an important transformation direction of the manufacturing industry. The quality of threaded fasteners is directly related to the reliability and safety of mechanical products. However, bolt workpieces are prone to cracks, scratches, wrinkles and geometric defects in the production process. Traditional artificial defect recognition has the problems of slow speed, low accuracy and high labor cost. Therefore, a workpiece recognition system based on machine vision is proposed to realize the automatic recognition of defective bolts. Firstly, the principle and use process of machine vision are introduced, and the system is developed in OpenCV open source vision library. Then the basic process and key technologies of defect recognition are studied. The key technologies include image graying, mean filtering, edge detection, threshold segmentation, contour extraction and other technologies. These technologies can greatly reduce the image size, remove most of the interference factors of the image, strengthen the target area in the image, improve the speed and accuracy of defect detection, and lay a theoretical foundation for subsequent system development. Then the workpiece recognition system is designed, including two modules: data set and defect recognition. The BP neural network is used to identify the defect, and the principle of this method and how to realize the defect detection function are studied. Finally, the defect workpiece recognition experiment was carried out. The system displayed the experimental results by labeling the defect type and displaying the code. The experimental results verified the accuracy and feasibility of the system. The recognition system has high reliability for bolt defect recognition, and has certain reference value for bolt defect recognition research based on machine vision.

articleTitle: A machine learning approach for recommending aerial target interventions in adversarial training scenarios
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: The challenge of generating appropriate intervention scenarios for aircraft guidance during complex countermeasure training incorporates multi-objective optimization, aerial vehicle swarm countermeasures, and associated fields. Predominantly, current studies are rooted in engineering manufacturing, urban development, aerospace, electric power, and biomedicine, with scarce research tackling time-sensitive, dynamic multi-objective problems in the context of aircraft guidance for countermeasure training. This study presents an optimal solution method, leveraging Markov decision-making and double-depth Q-learning. The methodology initiates by modelling the Markov decision process for multiple aerial vehicles engaging maritime targets. Subsequently, the algorithm process design utilizes dual-depth Q-learning. Finally, the method's validity is demonstrated through three aerial vehicles attack scenarios involving typical surface targets. Findings indicate that the optimal solution utilizing Markov decision-making and dual-depth Q-learning provides a feasible intervention solution, satisfying the critical requirements for quality, speed, and generalization of intervention outcomes during training exercises.

articleTitle: A study on keyword search framework based on end-to-end speech recognition in low-resource languages
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: The progression of voice keyword search has been intrinsically linked with the evolution of speech recognition technologies since their inception. In recent years, with the widespread application of end-to-end techniques in speech recognition, the academic community has become increasingly interested in the potential of end-to-end techniques for voice keyword search. However, the study of keyword retrieval in adhesive speech under low-resource conditions remains a relatively overlooked domain. To address the unique attributes and inherent challenges of low-resource languages, this study has designed a keyword search framework based on end-to-end speech recognition specifically for such languages. By leveraging phonetically similar speech and integrating multiple pre-trained language models, performance improvements in the target language were achieved. Moreover, the integration of the attention mechanism further optimized the feature extractor in speech recognition, ensuring the model's higher efficiency and accuracy when dealing with these complex linguistic scenarios. In conclusion, this study offers a viable solution for voice keyword search in low-resource languages.

articleTitle: Improved OpenPose for multi-person pose estimation and behavior recognition
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: In response to the sluggishness of multi-person pose estimation algorithms, rendering real-time pose estimation unattainable and restricting the output to human keypoints alone, practical behavior recognition applications remain unfeasible. Propose a lightweight attitude estimation method that introduces a deep separable convolutional structure and improves its pre-feature extraction module to improve target detection speed. Simultaneously, an adopted dual-stream adaptive graph convolutional network, Two-Stream Adaptive Graph Convolutional Networks (2s-AGCN) , leverages the key point information extracted by OpenPose for skeleton-based action recognition. On the MSCOCO dataset, in comparison to prevalent algorithms like OpenPose, AlphaPose, and HRNet, this algorithm attains an 85.2% accuracy rate in human key point recognition. While upholding detection precision, it reduces the computational complexity of the base model by 33.7×109 and trims down the parameter count by 83.1%. On the NTU-RGB+D dataset, the algorithm achieves a 95.3% accuracy rate on the X-View benchmark set, demonstrating a slight advantage over its counterparts. And it can effectively detect behavior recognition for human pose estimation in real-time.

articleTitle: Modeling and simulation of a UAV dynamic model for air quality monitoring
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: Quadrotor UAV is widely used in modern life. Its lightweight structure, maneuverability and controllability make it an important tool in many fields, such as power inspection, soil and air quality monitoring, and real-time tracking of sudden pollution events. Therefore, it is very important to study the dynamic model of this UAV. This article first introduces the background and significance of the UAV modeling and simulation, summarizes the research status and application scenarios at home and abroad, and emphasizes its development prospects. Then, in the third paragraph, the principle and modeling process of high-altitude air quality monitoring quadrotor UAV are described in detail, including the establishment of aerodynamic model and the design of air quality monitoring scheme. Finally, in the fourth stage, the simulation is carried out on the Matlab/Simulink simulation platform based on the dynamic model. The results show that the model can meet the flight control requirements of UAV by controlling the motor speed through PID controller. These studies provide important theoretical support for improving the performance and application of UAV

articleTitle: 3D reconstruction algorithm based on symmetric information
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: 3D reconstruction based on single-view input has long been an important and challenging problem in the field of computer vision. The establishment of large-scale 3D model datasets and the advancements in deep learning have made the utilization of deep neural networks a mainstream approach for single-view 3D reconstruction. While existing methods have achieved varying degrees of success, there are still limitations in terms of reconstruction accuracy and generalization capability across different object categories. Through analysis, it is evident that almost all man-made objects possess symmetry. Combining symmetric information with implicit representations can enhance the precision of implicit expressions. In this study, a symmetric plane detection algorithm is designed using the centroid, covariance matrix, and feature vectors of point clouds to acquire the symmetric information of the model. The Signed Distance Function (SDF) is chosen as the implicit representation of the reconstructed 3D object. Symmetric information is utilized to refine SDF values, thus enhancing the accuracy of the model. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method outperforms state-of-the-art reconstruction algorithms in terms of both the quality of reconstructed 3D models and the generalization to novel object types.

articleTitle: Optimisation strategy for multi-AGV multi-task assignment scheduling based on improved particle swarm genetic algorithm
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: In this paper, against the background of applying AGV-related technologies in manufacturing factories, we study the multiple AGV path planning and the key problem of task allocation scheduling. For the multi-AGV multi-task allocation problem, a multi-AGV multi-task allocation scheduling optimization strategy based on improved particle swarm genetic algorithm is proposed. Firstly, the constraint equations are established for this problem, and the optimal objective model of task allocation is established based on particle swarm algorithm, and the optimization of the optimization space is carried out using improved particle swarm genetic algorithm, which accelerates the convergence speed of the objective function, and finds the near optimal solution faster and with better search results than the classical algorithm. solution faster than the classical algorithm, and the optimisation result is also better. Based on this algorithm, a periodic task allocation strategy is proposed, which takes into account the priority, existing path planning, cost minimisation and other factors, and adds tasks to the queue to wait, which also achieves the optimal total cost. Design the simulation system to simulate the real factory map, order tasks and vehicle configuration, etc., and test the path planning, obstacle avoidance planning, task assignment scheduling and other functions of multiple AGVs. In the experiment, the path planning algorithm can plan a reasonable shortest path according to the starting point and the end point, and the obstacle avoidance planning algorithm can replan collision-free routes according to the original routes in the conflict area for task assignment

articleTitle: Fire emergency plan generation and dynamic optimization method based on knowledge graph and improved whale optimization algorithm
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: With the continuous development of modern society and the accelerated urbanization process, computer technology has made significant progress in the field of fire emergency management. With the emergence of knowledge graphs and various optimization algorithms, we can better organize and utilize relevant information in fire emergency management to prepare for potential fire incidents in the future. At present, there are some problems of low matching speed and lack of accuracy in the common methods of generating and optimizing preplans. Therefore, this paper proposes a dynamic optimization emergency plan based on knowledge graph and whale optimization algorithm (WOA). First, the knowledge graph of emergency response for fire emergencies, which integrates emergency resources in multiple fields, is constructed by combining knowledge graph technology to provide support for the accurate generation and optimization of emergency plans. Secondly, the average group distance formula is used to update the whale population position matrix to avoid the randomness of the individual vector selection of the emergency plan. Flipped learning strategies are then introduced to generate inverse solutions for native populations, improve the quality of native populations, further accelerate the rate of algorithm convergence, and provide a dynamic optimization process of contingency plans. Due to the introduction of the Gaussian random path strategy in the local optimization phase of the whale optimization algorithm, the global intelligence capabilities and local optimization possibilities of the pre-project optimization algorithm are enhanced. Finally, through multigroup test function simulation experiments and emergency fire and rescue intervention scenario experiments, the results show that advanced whale optimization algorithms based on knowledge graphs have significantly improved convergence accuracy, convergence rate, and stability compared to comparative algorithms, making the intelligent algorithms proposed in this paper an important theoretical and practical application in the field of planning Emergencies and emergency situations.

articleTitle: Camera-Lidar fusion algorithm formed by fast sparse encoder and transformer decoder
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: Multi modal fusion is an important part of the automatic driving perception system. In order to raise the fusion accuracy of the target motion attributes and adapt to different traffic scenarios, the best sensor combination scheme has always been explored. Large models and high performance chips are constantly iterated and updated in the field of automatic driving. However, the fusion technology also faces the problems of low accuracy, long model training period, the underutilization of original data inform ation, and the error in the spatial and temporal synchronization of the sensor. In order to improve the accuracy of target fusion, this paper proposes an end to end efficient multi modal Camera Lidar fusion algorithm. Firstly, it is necessary to encode the 3D coordinates of the point cloud into multi modal tokens to generate location aware features, and projected into the image and lidar space for coordinate encode. Then, the introduction of a variable transform method can effectively shorten the feat ure qu ery time and improve the overall detection efficiency. Finally, we recommend adding a fusion post processing at the end of the model, which belongs to the method of combining pre fusion and post fusion, The purpose of this is to be able to solve more corne r cases. By comparing with the existing fusion algorithms, the conclusion is that the mAP and NDS of the new method proposed in this paper are relatively high, implicitly encoding technology is applied to the multi modal features, avoiding the bias existin g in the explicit cross view feature alignment. The transform method can enhance the adaptability and robustness of the model and promote the development of high precision and fast fusion algorithms.

articleTitle: Development of a multi-component force measurement platform for vector thrust calibration of aviation engines
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: Compared with the single multi-component sensor, the combined multi-component platform has higher measurement accuracy and smaller coupling error. In this paper, a four-column sensor element with self-decoupling function is developed through theoretical force analysis of a three-component platform with symmetrical mechanism layout, and the structure of the sensor element, anti-biased load ability and long-term stability of the sensor element are analyzed in detail, so as to improve the performance index of the sensor element itself. At the same time, by developing the decoupling elements of the cross symmetrical structure with good elasticity under certain stiffness conditions, a three-component force measuring platform with high accuracy and good mechanical decoupling function is formed. This platform is combined with the multi-degree of freedom vector center loading device which can rotate 360 degrees and load continuously in the range of plus or minus 25 degrees. Together, it constitutes a new device for aero engine vector calibration, which can meet the experimental requirements of vector engine and vector nozzle, and has great significance for promoting the progress of vector thrust technology of vector engine, and can provide strong technical support for the development and test of advanced turbofan engine in the future.

articleTitle: Image defogging algorithm based on physical prior and contrast learning
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: Deep learning-based defogging methods can generate defogging results with high evaluation indexes end-to-end through the training of a large amount of data, but most of the existing methods do not make use of physical a priori with better defogging effects, and the use of synthetic data does not cope well with practical application scenarios due to the difficulty of obtaining supervised data, and the generalisation and robustness of the trained models are difficult to be guaranteed. Therefore, to address the above problems, this paper incorporates physical a priori such as non-local, dark channel and bright channel into deep learning, and introduces the contrast learning method in self-supervised learning, which constrains the distance between the data by the extracted features, ensures the effective use of the real data, and improves the model's defogging quality and generalisability. In order to meet the high-quality requirements of computer vision systems for images, an interactive tool is designed through relevant software and calls the function of the haze removal algorithm designed in this paper to realise the functions of capturing real-time scene images and removing haze from images in different ways.

articleTitle: Research on physical phenomena based group intelligent optimisation algorithm and engineering applications
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: Swarm intelligence optimisation algorithm is currently a hot spot in the field of algorithm research, and this paper focuses on swarm intelligence optimisation algorithm based on physical phenomena and applies the algorithm in engineering practice. This paper firstly proposes the improved Henry's gas solubility algorithm with Lévy motion and the Henry's gas solubility algorithm with Brownian motion, and the improved algorithms are verified to have strong stability and robustness through testing. Secondly, an Archimedes optimisation algorithm based on buoyancy energy for hybrid Lévy flight and tangent flight is proposed, which is verified to be able to converge in a shorter time and be closest to the theoretical optimum through testing. The paper concludes with the optimisation of two important parameters in the support vector machine model by dividing the UCI dataset in four different domains into a training set, a test set, and data preprocessing, and finally classifying the test set. It is concluded that the classification accuracy of the seven optimised algorithms on the datasets is significantly higher than that of the arithmetic original method, and the two optimal algorithms (TanLévyEAOA, BL-HGSO), which combine the advantages of other algorithms, have the highest classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Person re-identification algorithm based on identity information matrix
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: In order to overcome the domain shift problem in person re-identifacation algorithms, the paper proposes a person re-identifacation algorithm oriented towards identity information matrix. Firstly, the algorithm trained two dictionaries through low-rank decomposition. One dictionary represents interference information other than person in the image, and the other dictionary represents person feature information after removing interference information. Then, the person coding coefficients obtained through person feature information training are combined with identity information to train the classifier. At the same time, the consistency matrix and uncorrelation matrix of identity information are introduced to improve the effectiveness of identity information. Finally, the algorithm is tested based on a classifier. The experiment shows that the rank1 value of the algorithm is within PRID2011, VIPeR, i_LIDS and CHUK01 datasets achieved 41.20%, 50.32%, 82.27%, and 75.41% respectively, which is superior to other newer person re-identifacation methods. The paper introduces an identity information matrix to overcome the domain shift problem caused by changes in background, lighting, and other factors, which can improve the person re-identifacation rate to a certain extent.

articleTitle: Research on strawberry picking robot based on remote image transmission and visual localization
publicationTitle: 5th International Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Manufacturing (AIAM 2023)
abstract: Robot harvesting technology is one of the key research topics in China's agricultural field. The current picking robots have problems such as blow positioning accuracy, long picking cycles, and poor universality of fruit-picking types. Large-scale seasonal fruits rely on manual picking. This article focus on analyzing the machine vision system and end-picking technology of autonomous picking robots. Multiple visual recognition algorithms for detecting crops are compared, and the research focus of fruit-grabbing devices is summarized. Biomimetic technology was used for mechanism design, and bionic robots were used as the movement method, greatly reducing the difficulty of picking and innovating the form of robots. We adopt remote image transmission technology for real-time data exchange. positioning technology, the positioning and navigation of the strawberry robot were achieved, achieving motion control of the strawberry picking robot. Through practical proof, the human-machine collaboration mode reduces costs and improves productivity.
